## Elmhurst Example

### Obtain Data

```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roualdes/data/master/elmhurst.csv"
elmhurst <- read.csv(url)
head(elmhurst)
elmReg <- lm(gift_aid ~ family_income, data = elmhurst)

income <- data.frame(family_income = seq(from = 0, to = 250, by = 25))

income.mil <- data.frame(family_income = 1000)
predict.lm <- lm(elmReg, income)
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(e = rstandard(elmReg))
yhat <- fitted(elmReg)
```
